is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr-west (L1014F) and Ace-1(R) (G119S) (page 3, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper provides counts of field-collected mosquitoes categorized by kdr phenotype (RR=63, RS=38, SS=87) on page 8.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-collected mosquitoes were obtained from Soumousso, Burkina Faso (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting behavioral assays and genotyping on field-collected and laboratory-reared mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as Soumousso, Burkina Faso (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was published in 2024 and describes recent field collections for the experiments.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new behavioral assays and genotyping performed on field-collected mosquitoes from Soumousso.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype counts for the field-collected mosquitoes are provided in the main text (page 8).

assessment.summary: This study investigated the non-contact detection of pyrethroids (permethrin, deltamethrin, alpha-cypermethrin) in Anopheles gambiae s.l. mosquitoes. It included both laboratory strains and field-collected mosquitoes from Burkina Faso. The study genotyped field-collected mosquitoes for kdr and Ace-1 mutations and analyzed their behavioral response (takeoff) to insecticide headspace.
